instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Digital lending platform offering point-of-sale consumer financing and SME working capital loans through an API-integrated credit decisioning engine. Underwritten €120M in loans across 40 merchant partners. Risk scoring combines traditional bureau data with open banking transaction analysis. Evaluating real-time affordability assessment enhancements. The organization has significant capital, talent depth, and existing technology infrastructure, but internal processes are designed for stability and risk management — not speed. Innovation initiatives must navigate procurement, legal, compliance, and IT security review before receiving green-light. The key challenge is not resource availability but organizational velocity.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.
answers.additionalContext: We underwent a significant restructuring 6 months ago, consolidating 5 business units into 3 and reducing headcount by 12%. The remaining teams are stretched thin managing the same workload with fewer people. Morale has stabilized but is still recovering. Any innovation initiative must be achievable without adding burden to already-overloaded teams and should visibly improve their daily work experience.

input.changes_since_last: Acquired 6 new enterprise clients. Expanded into adjacent market. Digital maturity improving.

opportunities.title: Standardize and Automate Enterprise Sales Playbook
opportunities.rationale: To achieve the €50M ARR target, Orbit must move beyond ad-hoc sales efforts by formalizing a repeatable enterprise motion. This minimizes dependency on individual 'star' employees (addressing talent barriers) and allows for managed growth during periods of high staff strain.

first_actions: Map the end-to-end process for converting an SME lead into a recurring contract.
Develop a tiered sales playbook defining handoffs between product, compliance, and sales.
Implement standardized CRM logging templates specifically tailored to enterprise risk assessment data.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of sales cycle time for new enterprise clients by 20% within H2.
milestones: Playbook draft completed and signed off by Sales/Legal teams.
Internal training session conducted for all remaining staff on the new methodology.
Pilot tracking of three new deals using the standardized process.

opportunities.title: Enhance Real-Time Affordability and Predictive Risk Modeling
opportunities.rationale: Building on the existing credit decisioning engine, enhancing real-time affordability assessment is critical for retaining a conservative risk profile while accelerating volume. This leverages core technical strength and immediately addresses both growth potential and regulatory due diligence.

first_actions: Identify key data points (e.g., recurring bills, unusual transaction patterns) that signal immediate affordability stress.
Model the integration of predictive AI scoring directly into the API decisioning layer (API-first approach).
Conduct a joint review with Compliance/Legal to ensure model explainability and adherence to evolving fintech regulations.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in loan default rate associated with newly funded loans by 5% within 12 months.
milestones: Pilot model successfully back-tested against historical poor-performing loan cohorts.
Compliance sign-off achieved for the new scoring methodology.
Integration and internal testing of the enhanced score in a sandbox environment.

next_steps.action: Conduct a 'Workload Audit' to pinpoint the 3 most resource-intensive operational bottlenecks that can be solved by low-effort automation (e.g., automated document parsing, repetitive compliance checks).

Establish a dedicated 'Innovation Governance Board' composed of representatives from Product, Compliance, Legal, and Engineering. This board must meet bi-weekly to enforce speed and visibility on process improvements.

Formalize a 'Growth Hypothesis Workshop' session focused solely on defining the value proposition and pricing structure for recurring revenue models, separating this strategic exercise from day-to-day operations.

key_weaknesses: Organizational Velocity: Internal processes (procurement, legal review) introduce significant non-technical friction and latency to innovation initiatives.
Operational Fatigue Risk: The core team is currently severely stretched due to restructuring, meaning sustained effort on high-complexity projects risks burnout and reduced quality.

Governance Bottlenecking: While the technical capability exists for advanced products (e.g., real-time scoring), the institutional processes are not agile enough to capitalize on market opportunities quickly.

improvements: Successfully digitized and optimized customer onboarding, reducing average time from 12 days to 5 days.
Established a clear validation point for new digital flows with measurable improvements in early NPS scores (+22 points).
Secured significant market traction by acquiring 6 new enterprise clients.
persistent_gaps: The core barrier remains organizational velocity; process governance is still the primary speed limiter, despite successful execution on customer-facing flows.
Staff resource allocation (talent/time) remains critically strained following restructuring, demanding highly focused and low-overhead innovation efforts.
achieved_milestones: Launch of the enhanced digital onboarding flow.
Defining concrete expansion targets toward €50M ARR over a 5-year horizon.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has demonstrated strong execution capability by streamlining customer journeys and achieving early enterprise sales success. The focus has shifted from proving market fit to solving internal process bottlenecks to achieve scalable growth.
